program.name: Psychology
program.summary: BSc Psychology, 3 years; English track with a numerus fixus of 250 places and a selection procedure (a Dutch track is also offered).

costs.note: Institutional fee for non-EU/EEA students, 2027-2028: €12,652 a year (Psychology is an Alpha-Gamma programme).

admissions.threshold: Psychology (English track): 3 (I)GCSEs (A-C or 4-9) and 3 full A-Levels (A-C), six different subjects, including A-Level Mathematics, plus English. The English track has an intake restriction, so a selection procedure is part of admission.

english.min_score: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, at least 5.5 in each section; TOEFL iBT 90 (at least 21 per section, scale before January 2026) or 4.5 (new scale); Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 169 (162 per section).
english.notes: An IB Diploma taught in English with an English exam subject exempts you from a test.

admissions.threshold: Psychology (English track): IB Diploma with Mathematics Applications and Interpretations or Analysis and Approaches (SL or HL). The English track has an intake restriction, so a selection procedure is part of admission.

english.min_score: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, at least 5.5 in each section; TOEFL iBT 90 (at least 21 per section, scale before January 2026) or 4.5 (new scale); Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 169 (162 per section).
english.notes: An IB Diploma taught in English with an English exam subject exempts you from a test.

admissions.threshold: Psychology (English track): a secondary school diploma equivalent to the Dutch VWO diploma, plus Twente's English and mathematics requirements. The English track has an intake restriction, so a selection procedure is part of admission.

english.min_score: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, at least 5.5 in each section; TOEFL iBT 90 (at least 21 per section, scale before January 2026) or 4.5 (new scale); Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 169 (162 per section).
english.notes: An IB Diploma taught in English with an English exam subject exempts you from a test.

deadline.note: Applications after 15 January 2027 are not accepted; selection in February-March 2027.
